name: Ryoujoku Hishoshitsu 2 ~Midou Shirou Hen~
original_name: 凌辱秘書室2～御童志狼篇～
source:
Midou Shirou manipulates females’ body and mind at will, as the legitimate successor of the dreadful, evil fist, the “Obscene Vortex Core Fist”.

Of course, that is nothing but his secret identity. He worked as a respectable employee of a high-tech development enterprise, until…

One day, the situation suddenly changed as he came face-to-face with a conspiracy shrouded in mystery. He receives a missive from Yuuzuki Yukino, Internal Investigation Bureau’s top agent dispatched directly from headquarters, to settle this incident once and for all.

[Edited from [url=https://j-addicts.de/vn-of-the-month-december-2003/]j-addicts[/url]]
translation:
御堂志狼作為可怕邪拳「淫渦核拳」的正統繼承人，能隨意操縱女性的身體與心靈。

當然，那只是他的秘密身分。他原本是高科技開發企業中受人尊敬的員工，直到……

某天，局勢因一場被謎團籠罩的陰謀驟變。他收到內務調查局首席探員夕月由貴乃從總部直接派來的密令，要徹底平息這起事件。

[改編自[url=https://j-addicts.de/vn-of-the-month-december-2003/]j-addicts[/url]]
